connector.name: E2LLM
connector.registryDescription: E2LLM gives your AI eyes and hands in a real browser: structured perception (SiFR) plus action.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.e2llm.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.e2llm, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer mk_… static API key from your e2llm.com dashboard. Use this api. endpoint for programmatic / CI clients; use the mcp. endpoint above for interactive browser OAuth login (no header required).
